items.title: How two engineer side projects became the agent taking action inside Dropbox
items.summary: Two side projects explored a new way to get work done with files already in Dropbox. Here’s how engineers brought them together and turned those experiments into a new customer experience.
items.creator: Daniel Reiter Horn,Rich Chan

items.title: How AI-assisted development helped us build the new Dropbox experience
items.summary: From sharing features across web and desktop to testing the details customers depend on, this is how AI-assisted development helped our engineers deliver the updated Dropbox experience.
items.creator: Daniel Reiter Horn,Rich Chan,Pravi Garg,Sourabh Yerfule,Gennadiy Civil
